notes:
From repair-shop (from: repair-shop), refitted Tue Oct 27 and merged on the REDESIGN 2 master (frozen 9:17am). A small engine shop runs like a device repair shop: the machine is dropped off, a bench check is OK'd, a written estimate is OK'd before any work, a part is ordered, and READY comes before the pick-up. No base plug-in or old flowchart existed (new profession); the plug-in is built from the trade's norm.
Two companies: Lee's Engine Shop (the master's barbershop, flow A: the shop) and Lee Mobile Mower (the master's Lee Home Services, flow B: a mobile mechanic at yards and garages). Kinds of work: plumbing became mower repair, electrical became generator service, the later NEW kind is snow blower service (B) and bike repair (A). People: Riley and Avery became Wes and Dana (the shop); Jordan and Casey became Marcus and Tara (mobile), so the master's pronouns still fit (Jordan he, Casey she). Addresses: 310 Mill Rd (the shop), 27 Birch Ln (Alex), 75 Ridge Rd (the second site).
No license: small engine repair needs no person license; the business gives its registration where the city or state asks (S1-60 '1 A license' and S2-28 '1 Yes, each one' are off; S11-42's two license branches are off). The sign-up license sentences (S1-38's loop, S1-60, S2-06, S2-21's table, S2-22, S11-48) are reworded as registration only. A brand's own warranty work is only for an authorized dealer of that brand (pf.rules.brand_warranty, a switch).
Flow A money: main visit|none|counter (a push mower that won't start: the $45 bench check is promised, Wes's written estimate is $110 carburetor rebuild + $15 spark plug = $125 with the check included), list|none|counter ($35 blade sharpening), visit|none|bill (the bill goes with READY), list|deposit|counter ($140 riding mower battery and starter: $40 deposit orders it, $100 at the counter). The shop saves no card and takes no full price: no cancel or no-show fee at the shop.
Flow B money: main list|card|bill ($179 riding mower tune-up at the customer's place; a card is saved for the $89 trip fee, which is the late-cancel and no-show fee, charged only on Sam's yes, and owed after a no to a visit price: B4-14), visit|card|bill (a mower that won't start, priced at the visit), list|card|card (the saved card charged at DONE), photos|deposit|bill (a riding mower deck rebuild priced from photos of the deck and model plate: $640, $160 deposit, $480 on the bill). No full price anywhere. All amounts have names per path.
Facts: dropoff (a machine left at the shop), photos (a deck rebuild priced from photos), extrawork (a part found at the bench, OK'd first). No documents fact: the written estimate is the visit path's own price OK (A8-29 / B8-93), so B8-93's 'An estimate becomes its own job' branch is off. No switches. Settings: A a set start (drop-off slots), B a 2-hour window; cutoff 24 hours before.
Safety: fire, smoke from the engine, a carbon monoxide alarm or someone cut stops the booking; a fuel leak or strong gas smell, a generator run indoors or a loose blade gets the safety steps, then the booking goes on, marked urgent. Fuel leaks found at the bench or at a home stop the work (A8-35 / B8-30). A child is never the person served (A4-24 / B4-32 'A child' off).
Own step: A8-x01, the fuel check at the counter (gas in the tank, old gas drained, any leak), a real first step of this trade. Reminder lines: carry the machine upright with the gas cap tight, bring the key.
Offs for work this shop never has: video or phone (A4-01, B4-01), plans and insurance, packages, a person by name, plan steps, rented items, 'too few booked', a child left, stage billing, next visit at checkout, a signed contract, nobody-home branches and sent-now steps.
Kept: 'leak' (a fuel leak is this trade's own word) and 'drain' (draining old gas).
Not sure (for the verifier): S1-13's sign-up example card still lists 'Paid in full' lines and a $20 fee for services this shop never prepays (master text, not an overlay word); A8-02 keeps the 'something required is missing' branch for a riding mower with no key; the engine health check (B) is a free list|none|none example in the master's amounts that no listed path uses.
